chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Al-Hasan Al-Attar, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'He will not attain my intercession, the one who belittles his prayer, and he will not return to me at the Fountain, no, by Allah. He will not attain my intercession, the one who drinks the intoxicant, and he will not return to me at the Fountain, no, by Allah.'
ai.seo_question: Who is excluded from the Prophet's intercession and drinking from his Fountain?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, the Prophet (peace be upon him) links the neglect of Salah and the consumption of Khamr (intoxicants) as dual barriers to attaining his intercession (Shafa'ah) and drinking from his Fountain (Al-Hawd). This emphasizes that ritual prayer is the pillar of faith, while intoxicants corrupt the intellect, both of which are essential for the believer's ultimate success in the Hereafter according to Shia tradition.
